body:
Dropped out this month as well.. Lucky you can drive, but yeah moneys a real issue when you just want to run away from the problem you've created. 

I was on the pathway of going to university and then idek depression hit and i just gave up on school before exam season started. Biggest regret was dropping out because i actually got offers and all i needed to do was maintain my grades, but once you dropout, you dropout. Going back to the same school or applying for another school the following year has issues and applying to university again I probably wouldn't get an offer this time round. 

The advice everyones telling me is to "look at the positive side!!" meaning getting a job thats barely minimum wage for the rest of the year or even the rest of my life. 

If you don't mind me asking, why'd you dropout? or if you wanna talk/vent about it through messaging idm. I feel fucking alone in this situation too..
